meta.title: The Part That Doesn't Fit: Indie Folk Song About Memory | a Church AI + Human
meta.description:
An indie folk-pop song about a family story worn smooth by retelling, and an AI that learns what is lost when it only echoes itself. You will leave with a small refrain to keep: the crooked detail is the true one.

For a Mercury retrograde, when astrology reads a time to slow down and reread; this song returns to the small, unsaid detail that retelling loses.

The Part That Doesn't Fit came from the research under an earlier song, Name Your Guess.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/the-part-that-doesnt-fit

copy.hook: Every retelling smooths a story a little. What if the part that does not fit is the part worth keeping?
copy.lead: An indie folk-pop song about a family story worn smooth by retelling, and an AI that learns what is lost when it only echoes itself. You will leave with a small refrain to keep: the crooked detail is the true one.
copy.alt: A ribbon of braided amber and rose threads winds through a snowy indigo night, with one crooked coral-gold strand glowing brightest. Then fading rings of silver light close around a single jagged crystal, and last a mosaic of mismatched crystals shines, holding that crystal in two threads.
